The mechanism involves a regulatory pathway where corticosterone modulates MAPE2 activity via a receptor, and Roxarsone may influence this pathway by acting as a modulator of corticosterone's effects. This integrated explanation highlights the role of corticosterone as a mediator in the relationship between Roxarsone and MAPE2, supported by the observed chain of targets.
